title: Do Not Sell the Gospel
description: In this sermon, Pastor John Piper reflects on a message he heard 36 years ago about the story of the rich young ruler. The speaker emphasized the importance of letting go of worldly riches in order to follow Jesus. Piper expands on this idea by also referencing the stories of Lot's wife, the obedient servant, and the obedient Pharisee. He highlights the fact that no amount of money can replace Jesus as our ultimate treasure. The sermon encourages listeners to remember these biblical examples and prioritize their relationship with Christ above all else.
